blocks.x: A working definition of Capital Markets & Wealth Management for Banking & Financial Services: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.

The operating surface here spans Advisor research and prep, Reconciliation and breaks, Client reporting, Suitability and disclosure, Corporate actions processing. Each workflow enters the program measured — cycle time, error rate and cost per case — and leaves with its delta reported against the signed baseline.
